title: Black Panther
about: A new king returns to his hidden, high-tech African nation and faces a challenger with a claim to the throne.
cue: Serve the mains when the tribes gather at the waterfall for the challenge.

    StartersBusan gochujang honey wingsDouble-fried crispy wings in a sticky gochujang, honey and soy glazeHow to make it1kg chicken wings100g potato starch1 L vegetable oil, for frying2 tbsp gochujang3 tbsp honey2 tbsp soy sauce2 cloves of garlic, crushed1 tbsp sesame seedsToss the wings in the potato starch.Heat the vegetable oil to 160°C and fry the wings, then rest.Simmer the gochujang, honey, soy and garlic until glossy.Fry again at 190°C until crisp.Toss in the sauce and top with sesame.Heart-shaped herb dipRoast beet, garlic, lemon and dill in thick yoghurt, with warm flatbreadHow to make it2 beetroots300g Greek yoghurt1 clove of garlic, crushed1 lemon, juiced1 tbsp dill, chopped4 flatbreadsRoast the beetroot until tender, then peel and grate.Mix with the yoghurt, garlic, lemon juice and dill.Warm the flatbreads and serve with the deep purple dip.Beef suya skewers with onion and tomatoThe busy street market in Birnin ZanaHow to make itAs written, serves 4Thin beef rump strips coated in a peanut, ginger and chilli spice, grilled smoky on skewers and served with sliced tomato, red onion and lime.Blitz 80g roasted peanuts to a fine powder and mix with 2 tsp ground ginger, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cayenne, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder and 1 tsp salt.Slice 800g beef rump into thin strips, toss in oil and then in most of the spice.Thread onto soaked skewers and grill over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes a side.Scatter with the rest of the spice and serve with sliced tomato, red onion and lime.Puff-puff with chilli honeyStreet sweets from the chopped tomatoes1 red capsicum1 onion1/2 scotch bonnet chilli3 tbsp vegetable oil400g long grain rice700ml chicken stock1 tsp dried thyme800g chicken thighsBlitz the tomatoes, capsicum, onion and chilli.Fry the blended sauce in oil until deep red.Stir in the rice, stock and thyme, cover and bake at 170°C.Grill the chicken thighs until charred and cooked through.Lay the chicken on the rice and serve.M'Baku's sweet potato and peanut stewThe mountain chief of the Jabari, up in the snowHow to make itAs written, serves 4Sweet potato, chickpeas and spinach simmered in a rich peanut, tomato and ginger sauce with chilli, over rice with roasted peanuts and coriander.Soften 1 onion, 3 garlic cloves and 1 tbsp grated ginger in oil.Add 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander and 1 chopped red chilli.Stir in 1 tin crushed tomatoes, 120g smooth peanut butter and 600ml vegetable stock.Add 800g diced sweet potato and 1 drained tin chickpeas and simmer 25 minutes.Stir in 120g spinach and lime juice.Serve over rice with roasted peanuts and coriander.SweetsFried plantain with honeyCaramelised ripe plantain with honey, chilli flakes and coconut ice creamHow to make it3 ripe plantains40g butter2 tbsp honey1 and steep.Strain and chill.Stir in the pineapple juice and lime juice.Pour over ice, top with sparkling water and add a lime wheel.
